en.title: Fossil fuels removed from revised COP31 draft deal
en.dek: Negotiators published a revised draft at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey that contains no mention of fossil fuels, reversing an earlier proposal to phase them out.
facts: Revised draft published at COP31 summit in Turkey contains no mention of fossil fuels
Earlier proposal included accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels
Removal of fossil fuel language reversed earlier draft language
Le Monde and DW confirm removal from revised text
body: Negotiators at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey published a revised draft deal that contains no mention of fossil fuels, according to Le Monde and DW.
An earlier version of the draft included accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels, but that language has been removed from the latest version.
The removal represents a significant shift in the negotiating text ahead of the summit's conclusion.
Diplomats and observers said the change came after intense pressure from countries reluctant to commit to phasing out fossil fuel production.
Le Monde reports the revision has drawn outcry from environmental groups who say the omission weakens the agreement's credibility.
DW notes the revised text now focuses on other climate measures while omitting the fossil fuel phase-out language that had appeared in earlier drafts.
The development highlights the ongoing tension between climate ambition and economic interests at the COP31 summit.
Negotiators continue to work on other aspects of the deal as the summit approaches its final stages.
en.context: COP31 is the latest United Nations climate summit, held in Turkey, where nearly 200 countries are negotiating a new global climate agreement. The negotiations have focused on mitigation, adaptation, and financing for climate action, with fossil fuel language being a particularly contentious point among delegations.

en.headline: Fossil fuels removed from revised COP31 draft text
en.body: Negotiators published a revised deal draft at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey that contains no mention of fossil fuels. An earlier proposal included accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels, according to Le Monde and DW.

it.headline: I combustibili fossili esclusi dalla bozza rivista dell'accordo della COP31
it.body: I negoziatori hanno pubblicato una bozza d'accordo rivista al vertice sul clima COP31 in Turchia che non contiene alcun accenno ai combustibili fossili. Una proposta precedente prevedeva un'azione accelerata per l'eliminazione graduale dei combustibili fossili, secondo quanto riportato da Le Monde e DW.

es.headline: Eliminan los combustibles fósiles del texto borrador revisado de la COP31
es.body: Los negociadores publicaron un borrador de acuerdo revisado en la cumbre del clima COP31 en Turquía que no contiene ninguna mención sobre los combustibles fósiles. Una propuesta anterior incluía una acción acelerada para eliminar progresivamente los combustibles fósiles, según informaron Le Monde y DW.

de.headline: Fossile Brennstoffe aus überarbeitetem COP31-Entwurf entfernt
de.body: Verhandlungsführer veröffentlichten auf dem Klimagipfel COP31 in der Türkei einen überarbeiteten Abkommensentwurf, der keine Erwähnung fossiler Brennstoffe enthält. Ein früherer Vorschlag enthielt laut Le Monde und DW eine beschleunigte Maßnahme zum Ausstieg aus fossilen Brennstoffen.

fr.headline: Les combustibles fossiles retirés du projet de texte révisé de la COP31
fr.body: Les négociateurs ont publié un projet d'accord révisé lors du sommet climatique COP31 en Turquie qui ne mentionne pas les combustibles fossiles. Une proposition antérieure prévoyait une action accélérée pour éliminer les combustibles fossiles, selon Le Monde et DW.

zh.headline: 修订版COP31草案文本中删除化石燃料
zh.body: 谈判代表在土耳其COP31气候峰会上发布了一份修订后的协议草案，其中未提及化石燃料。据《世界报》和DW报道，早先的提案包含加速淘汰化石燃料的行动。

pt.headline: Combustíveis fósseis removidos do texto preliminar revisto da COP31
pt.body: Negociadores publicaram um rascunho de acordo revisto na cimeira climática da COP31 em Turquia que não menciona combustíveis fósseis. Uma proposta anterior incluía uma ação acelerada para eliminar os combustíveis fósseis, segundo Le Monde e DW.

ko.headline: 개정된 COP31 초안 텍스트에서 화석 연료 삭제
ko.body: 협상가들은 터키에서 열린 COP31 기후 정상회의에서 화석 연료에 대한 언급이 없는 개정된 합의 초안을 발표했다. Le Monde와 DW에 따르면, 이전 제안에는 화석 연료 단계적 퇴출을 위한 가속화된 조치가 포함되어 있었다.

ja.headline: 改訂されたCOP31草案から化石燃料が削除
ja.body: トルコで開催されたCOP31気候サミットで、交渉団は化石燃料への言及を一切含まない改訂された合意草案を公表した。Le MondeとDWによると、以前の提案には化石燃料の段階的廃止に向けた加速的行動が含まれていた。
